name: aram-bridge
description: ARAM 내전 LCU 브릿지 — 롤 클라이언트 데이터를 Firebase로 전송

scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const out='dist/aram-bridge-v'+v+'.exe';execSync('pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --output '+out,{stdio:'inherit'});const buf=fs.readFileSync(out);const pe=buf.readUInt32LE(0x3C);buf.writeUInt16LE(2,pe+0x5C);fs.writeFileSync(out,buf);console.log('PE subsystem patched: WINDOWS (no console window)')"
